caveats: No POSIX kernel is involved: this is an import-level audit on Windows.

The dynamic pass flips sys.platform in a subprocess and blocks Windows-only modules; os.name is left alone because a Windows CPython cannot instantiate PosixPath, which would manufacture a failure instead of measuring one.
It therefore proves the import graph only: it cannot observe path semantics (separators, case sensitivity, locking, signals) that need a real POSIX host.
Harness hits are authoring tooling (runs/, probes/); they are counted but not treated as delivery defects.
